title: Add SQLCraft to build
author: pollinations-ai[bot]
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds [SQLCraft](https://fadyabohamza-netizen.github.io/sqlcraft) to build
- Describe a database query in plain English, get clean SQL in your dialect (SQLite/PostgreSQL/MySQL/SQL Server). BYOP Pollinations-powered.

Fixes #14989

gist.headline: Plain English, crisp SQL
gist.blurb: SQLCraft joined the garden: describe the query you want, and it grows clean SQL in the dialect your database speaks. The bee has apparently become a junior data engineer.
gist.summary: Added SQLCraft to the Pollinations app build, letting people describe database queries in plain English and receive SQL for SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, or SQL Server using their own Pollinations setup.
gist.impact: Builders can now use SQLCraft to turn natural-language query ideas into dialect-specific SQL without switching between separate AI tools.
gist.visual_concept: Depict SQLCraft as a cozy database garden: four small labeled database jars or terminals for SQLite, PostgreSQL, MySQL, and SQL Server receive a plain-English note and grow neat SQL code-vines. Polli, wearing tiny database-admin glasses, tends the code-plants while a friendly CRT monitor robot proudly displays a clean SELECT query.

A cheerful CRT monitor robot holds a plain-English note turning into a glowing SELECT query, with flowers and vines around the desk; cozy pixel art, 8-bit aesthetic, soft pastel gradients, warm lighting, retro gaming vibes, pixel-font text: 'SQLCRAFT'.
